action_items: Fix invalid DOM structure causing span/select/option nesting console errors in edit dialog rendering path (all scopes).
Restore green status for P0 Scope 1 calculation_methodology persistence contract tests (iter142 suite).
Re-run frontend read-only edit checks across Scope 1/2/3/Biogenic after above fixes to confirm console cleanliness and unchanged payload behavior.

Console hydration errors indicate unsafe/invalid DOM children in select/option rendering path; this is a release-blocking quality issue for strict runtime cleanliness criteria.

rca of the issue: Repro: login -> /ghg/scope1|scope2|scope3|biogenic -> click first edit row. Browser console repeatedly logs invalid nesting errors showing <span> rendered within <option>/<select> in facility select tree. Likely root cause is dynamic wrapper/instrumentation markup being injected into select option rendering path. Mitigation: ensure option children are plain text nodes and remove any wrapper elements from mapped options. Separate regression failure indicates custom-fuel edit contract expectations drifted vs current implementation in scope1 edit helper; align implementation or update stale contract assertions after verifying intended behavior.
